verdict.rationale: ReadMe's Linter lets writers define style rules in natural language and checks every page against them, Docs Audit runs those rules project-wide to surface style inconsistencies, and Reviews let you check changes with the AI Linter before merging/publishing — directly matching the story of automated pre-publish style checks. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation that the linter reliably catches real style-guide violations and confirmation it blocks publishing rather than just flagging.
